pages.title: Maids Feed For You
pages.text: With Touhou Little Maid installed, the maid's "feed animal" task follows this mod's rules:$(br2)she only feeds $(bold)domesticated$() animals below half hunger; she only uses food that the animal's diet allows and that actually has nutrition; and she keeps feeding until the animal is full.$(br2)Domesticated babies count too - a maid will fill them up so stalled growth resumes. (Wild babies never burn hunger and grow up on their own, so they need no feeding.)

pages.title: Jade Shows the Real State
pages.text: With Jade installed, looking at an animal first shows its $(bold)diet$() - herbivore, carnivore or omnivore, so you know at a glance what to feed it. Below that are its gender, domestication, pregnancy progress, post-birth cooldown, $(bold)next egg$() and $(bold)next feather$() countdowns, baby growth progress, hunger and starving status.$(br2)Looking at an incubating fertilized egg also shows its $(bold)incubation progress$().$(br2)This mod hides Jade's built-in "time until grown" countdown - vanilla growth timing no longer applies, so that number would be wrong.

pages.title: Maid Fishing & Breeding
pages.text: The maid's $(bold)fishing$() task follows the same limits as you: natural water, and a real fish near the bobber, or no bite. A maid lands the fish herself and collects the drops.$(br2)Breeding and hatching here also notify other mods: anything that changes breeding results - twins, breeding bonuses and the like - applies to babies born here and chicks hatched here.$(br2)See $(l:animalflee:fishing/fishing_overview)Fishing & Fish Farming$().
